ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity pixels (white) centrally with 15% low-intensity pixels (black) localized at the peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central high-intensity white region; solid black irregular banding along the entire trailing edge and tips; isolated dark focal spots on the left lobe mid-section and right lobe near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 92 degrees and moderate depth penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude; most pronounced 'peaks' are visible on the distal third of both lobes near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning into a sharp upward convex flare at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups located at both distal lobe tips, indicating localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the light-colored ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of barnacles at both fluke tips; irregular trailing edge profile with several deep jagged indentations on the left inner lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark circular pigmentation spot is visible in the upper-left interior quadrant of the fluke.
